rs.t: Price ₹79 is 198% above the absolute value of ₹26 (🛡️ Strict view, used for this verdict) (1 of 4 methods say cheap, 3 say expensive)

ch: Drops to Hold if the quality score falls below 70 (now 70); to Avoid below 50.
Buy zone: below ₹20 (25% under the absolute value ₹26, 🛡️ Strict view), if the view's own conditions hold, confidence is Medium or High and the trend is up. Accumulate zone: ₹27–₹36 (consensus ₹32).
Moves to Trim above ₹41 (30% over fair value).

Any new serious red flag (auditor resigns mid-term, pledge above 25%, SEBI order, negative net worth, weak cash conversion together with high accruals, distress with interest cover below 1.5×) moves it straight to Avoid.
